termination: The still-unfinished first update was stopped after the memory and paging measurements to avoid an unbounded multi-week replay.
attribution: The logical batch-16 full-sequence vocabulary logits saturated physical VRAM and paged heavily. This is a runtime batching failure, not a model-quality result and not a hard resource limit for compute-equivalent microbatching.
supported_repair: One logical-batch-16 replay may use physical microbatches of four with four gradient accumulations. Each microbatch loss must be weighted by its valid response-position count so the logical full-batch mean objective, sample order, optimizer updates, and imported-information budget remain fixed.
